import codecs, hashlib, json, platform, sys, unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

assert unicodedata.unidata_version == '16.0.0'
names=['iso2022_jp','iso2022_jp_1','iso2022_jp_2','iso2022_jp_3','iso2022_jp_2004','iso2022_jp_ext','iso2022_kr','hz']
alphabet=[0,10,14,15,27,36,38,40,41,46,64,65,66,67,68,70,73,74,78,79,80,81,90,92,126,127,128,255]
seed=175
count=2000
rows=[]
for name in names:
    state=seed
    def next_value():
        global state
        state=(state*1664525+1013904223)&0xffffffff
        return state>>8
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    for index in range(count):
        data=bytes(alphabet[next_value()%len(alphabet)] for _ in range(1+next_value()%29))
        if index%2==0: data=b'\x1b'+data
        policy=['strict','ignore','replace'][next_value()%3]
        split=next_value()%(len(data)+1)
        decoder=codecs.getincrementaldecoder(name)(policy)
        steps=[]
        for part,final in [(data[:split],False),(data[split:],False),(b'',True),(b'AB',True)]:
            try: result=['ok',list(map(ord,decoder.decode(part,final)))]
            except UnicodeDecodeError as error: result=['error',type(error).__name__,error.encoding,list(error.object),error.start,error.end,error.reason]
            except Exception as error: result=['error',type(error).__name__,str(error)]
            saved=decoder.getstate()
            steps.append([result,[list(saved[0]),str(saved[1])]])
            restored=codecs.getincrementaldecoder(name)(policy)
            restored.setstate(saved)
            decoder=restored
        decoder.reset()
        saved=decoder.getstate()
        steps.append([list(saved[0]),str(saved[1])])
        digest.update((json.dumps([list(data),policy,split,steps],separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode())
    rows.append({'name':name,'count':count,'digest':digest.hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps({'reference':{'version':sys.version,'unicode':unicodedata.unidata_version,'platform':platform.platform(),'byteorder':sys.byteorder},'seed':seed,'alphabet':alphabet,'generator':Path(__file__).read_text(),'cases':rows},indent=2))
